title: Supply Task Prioritization Framework and Dashboard
problem: Supply teams faced a large, diverse backlog of hotel and ticket issues with no structured, data-driven way to prioritize the highest-impact ones.
actions: Defined multi-variable business metrics incorporating hotel and ticket scores
Built a task prioritization framework to rank supply issues
Developed an operational dashboard to operationalize the prioritization logic
Trained supply teams on adoption and usage of the new system
results: Increased resolution of critical tasks by 25% (framing variants: increased focus on critical supply issues by 25%)
example_bullets: Designed and deployed a multi-metric task prioritization system that increased focus on critical supply issues by 25% through data-driven ranking and team training.

Established a task prioritization framework using multi-variable metrics (hotel vs. ticket scores) and trained supply teams on the new dashboard, driving a 25% increase in the resolution of critical tasks.
harvested_bullets: Developed a task prioritization dashboard using SQL to support business operations, defining multi-variable metrics to rank supply issues and deliver actionable reporting, increasing critical task resolution by 25%.

Created and rolled out a multi-metric supply task prioritization framework and operational dashboard by defining hotel/ticket scoring metrics and training supply teams on adoption; increased resolution of critical tasks by 25%.

title: Room-Type Mismatch Detection Using SQL and NLP
problem: Room-type mismatches between hotel listings, buried in large-scale unstructured description text, caused pricing inaccuracies and availability errors.
actions: Extracted large-scale listing data using SQL
Applied NLP techniques including lemmatization, TF-IDF, and edit distance (Levenshtein)
Built matching logic to detect inconsistencies between room descriptions
Validated detection performance against existing rules
results: Reduced downstream pricing and availability errors (framing variants: refined dynamic pricing accuracy)
example_bullets: Engineered an AI-driven solution for room-type mismatch detection, leveraging Python and SQL for large-scale data processing and applying NLP techniques (TF-IDF, Levenshtein Distance) to preprocess text, which boosted detection rates by 120%.
Refined dynamic pricing accuracy by combining large-scale analysis with NLP techniques (lemmatization, TF-IDF, edit distance) to detect room-type mismatches, increasing detection by 120%.
harvested_bullets: Built a room-type mismatch detection framework by extracting large-scale listing data with SQL and applying NLP (lemmatization, TF-IDF, Levenshtein) to match descriptions; improved mismatch detection rate by 120%.

Improved data quality and pricing accuracy by developing an analytical quality assurance system using Python, SQL, and NLP to process large-scale listing data, increasing the detection rate of room-type mismatches by 120%.
